violation_type.title: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach (26 TAC §746.2206(3)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach
violation_type.typical_finding: In the toddler room, there was insufficient number of toys and equipment accessible to children. Toys, books, and puzzles are stored on high shelves out of reach of children.

finding_variants.text: In the toddler room, there was insufficient number of toys and equipment accessible to children. Toys, books, and puzzles are stored on high shelves out of reach of children.
The classrooms had little to no toys available for children to initiate play. Toys were put up out of reach and had to be retrived by a caregiver.
During the application inspection, the facility does not have educational materials for children, such as arts supplies, books, and other activity materials in each classroom.
Equipment and supplies were not accessible to children in their room, not allowing them to participate in child-initiated activities.   Noted: This was addressed and activities were made accessible.
